tip_5lang.en: Stroll around the bustling central district to soak in the authentic local atmosphere of West Java, taking time to watch the vibrant street vendors while keeping an eye on your belongings.

tip_5lang.en: Discover the remnants of this historical railway line that once connected surrounding towns, and wear sturdy walking shoes to safely navigate the uneven tracks and overgrown paths.
